draft.body:
Dear Owner,

We refer to report nr-0106/26 Jan 2025 of MV TORMAR SPRING.

For the purpose of the charter party, please note the following off-hire period:

1. Date/Time of Stop: 26 Jan 2025, 0610 UTC
2. Date/Time of Resume: 26 Jan 2025, 1140 UTC
3. Duration: 5 hours 20 minutes
4. Reason: Main engine stopped to repair a hydraulic oil leak on the steering gear
5. Charter Party Clause: Off-hire clause 17 (NYPE 1993 model)
6. Bunkers Used During Stoppage: VLSFO 1.1 t (consumed by generators and boiler for the owners' account)

We respectfully request your acknowledgment of the above off-hire declaration and that the mentioned bunkers remain for the owners' account.

Thank you for your attention.

Operations
MV TORMAR SPRING
